subject: session date
fact: A'lai showed up at the Oak Tree Apothecary at half past two on the day of the murder.
source_quote: A'lai had shown up at the Oak Tree Apothecary at half past two on the day of the murder

subject: dragonborn count
fact: A dragonborn had arrived at the apothecary, per the testimony of Nibbles the squirrel.

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve is the bottom of the world, where a dwarf was in chains.
source_quote: Velkynvelve, which is where this all started: a dwarf in the wrong place, in chains, at the bottom of the world

subject: polymorph spell duration
fact: A polymorph spell lasts an hour.
source_quote: A polymorph spell lasts an hour

subject: time gap between sightings
fact: There was a minimum two-hour gap between the Sylvira lookalike being seen in the kitchens and coming down the stairs.

subject: sapphire and locket value relation
fact: You can't steal a locket off someone who's alive and holding it; you need the sapphire to find a locket that's already lost.
source_quote: you can't steal a locket off someone who's alive and holding it. You need the sapphire to find a locket that's already lost

subject: Daral's remaining time
fact: Daral looked like someone counting down.
source_quote: He looked alive, technically, though with the specific quality of someone counting down

subject: sequence of Daral's poison exposure
fact: Daral licked his finger, licked the book, then licked his finger again.
source_quote: he had licked his finger, licked the book, then licked his finger again

subject: safe accessibility
fact: Glabbagool could eat through the safe, as walls present no meaningful obstacle to his methodology.
source_quote: I guess I could have eaten through the safe. It would have taken a while

subject: monograph request sequence
fact: Fembris Lancer and Elian both asked for a monograph in the same afternoon.
source_quote: First Fembris, now Elian. Two men after a monograph in one afternoon

subject: sequence of Glabbagool's emotional response
fact: Glabbagool first declared the notes not nutritious, then expressed grief about the loss of cheese.
source_quote: This is not nutritious. ... I remember when there was cheese. Perhaps if we had some cheese

subject: gap size for Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool distinguished between a gap that admitted a gelatinous cube and one that did not.
source_quote: Glabbagool had made the distinction between a gap that admitted a gelatinous cube and a gap that did not

subject: time of Sylvira lookalike sightings
fact: The Sylvira lookalike was seen in the kitchens around one in the morning and coming down the stairs between two and three.
source_quote: the Sylvira lookalike had been seen in the kitchens around one in the morning. She'd been seen coming down the stairs between two and three
